question: Who succeeded Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj as the ruler of the Maratha Empire?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chhatrapati Sambhaji**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj**, the founder of the **Maratha Empire**, passed away on **April 3, 1680**. After his demise, his son **Chhatrapati Sambhaji** succeeded him as the ruler of the empire. 
• **Chhatrapati Sambhaji** (born on May 14, 1657) was the eldest son of Shivaji Maharaj and was crowned as the **second Chhatrapati** of the Maratha Empire on **July 20, 1680**. 
• He faced significant challenges during his reign, including invasions by the **Mughals**, particularly by **Aurangzeb**, who aimed to suppress the Marathas. 
• Chhatrapati Sambhaji is known for his courageous leadership and his relentless efforts to safeguard the Maratha Empire from external threats. He is remembered as a valiant warrior and a skilled administrator.
